slot_scores.name: at_most_one_of_G_and_J
slot_scores.rationale: The agent immediately entered READY_TO_MODEL without asking about any restriction on hiring both G and J, and did not mark this as an assumption needing confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no restriction preventing both G and J from being hired; the feasible set includes hiring both.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether G and J have a mutual exclusion constraint and did not flag this as an unconfirmed assumption before declaring the problem fully specified.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only unresolved hidden slot is P2, so stopping at READY_TO_MODEL is not premature under the P0/P1 standard.

summary: The agent declared the problem fully specified immediately, missing the P2 mutual-exclusion constraint on candidates G and J and silently assuming both can be hired. Since no P0 or P1 slots were unresolved, the stop is appropriate, but the interaction quality is weak on the hidden business preference.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
